dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, is your cousin's hair long?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ɪz jʊr ˈkʌzənz ˈhɛr ˈlɔːŋ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, he has short dark hair.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, hiː ˈhæz ˈʃɔːrt ˈdɑːrk ˈhɛr.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: OK. And I have long blond hair.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ənd aɪ ˈhæv ˈlɔːŋ ˈblɑːnd ˈhɛr.
